viral_own_script_analysis.cta: Cheers. This is Garvit, and you'll be seeing me again.
viral_own_script_analysis.what_made_it_viral: Authentic creator vulnerability and unapologetic Indian creator identity that converts casual viewers into core community members.

verdict.reasoning: Garvit's innate ability to deliver aggressive 'free tool / subscription arbitrage' hooks in natural Hinglish gets immediate attention and saves audience money. However, pairing his energetic delivery with competitor structural depth (real business use-cases, agentic workflows, and concrete multi-layer tutorials) will elevate him from a 'hacks curator' to an authoritative Indian AI entrepreneur.
verdict.recommended_hook_structure: [Aggressive Command / Financial Pattern Interrupt] + [Specific High-Ticket Tool/Brand] + [Zero-Dollar / 10x Efficiency Outcome in Hinglish]
verdict.recommended_body_structure: [Live Proof on Screen: 'Look here'] -> [The Exact 3-Step Architecture/Setup] -> [Real Indian Business Application/Comparison] -> [Clear Catch or Pro-tip for Authenticity]
verdict.recommended_cta_structure: Comment '[SINGLE_WORD]' to get the exact prompt / workflow template sent to your DMs.
avoid_these: Vague philosophical rants without actionable AI or tech takeaways
Promising tools as 100% free without upfront transparency on API costs (harms audience trust)
Generic prompt sharing without showing live visual outputs on screen
Relying solely on consumer AI hacks without showcasing business automation or monetization
